title: Forecast Retirement Without Resolution Rate
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:personal retirement_reason=* resolved=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(resolved="no",1,0))) as matched by retirement_reason
| eval retired_without_resolution_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - retired_without_resolution_pct
description: Measures the percentage of retired forecasts that end with retired without resolution by retirement reason.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which retirement reason are helping or hurting retired forecasts.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `retired without resolution` on `forecast:personal` events and summarize the hit rate by `retirement_reason`.
visualization: Table of retirement reason with percentage of retired forecasts ending with retired without resolution.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how often retired without resolution happens for each retirement reason so you can see where retired forecasts go smoothly or get stuck.
